user.title: Set up HeatWise
user.description: Only the name is required. Everything else is optional and can be changed later.

data_description.boiler_entity: Optional. Leave empty for a house heated only by air conditioners.
data_description.house_temp_sensor: Optional. Without it the thermostat's own reading is used.
data_description.persons: Optional. Without people HeatWise assumes someone is home.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional. A Schedule helper works best. Without it: comfort while someone is home.
data_description.language: Automatic follows Home Assistant. The panel and the decision texts use this language.
data_description.house_humidity_sensor: Optional. With it HeatWise keeps the house warm against mould when the humidity stays high.

equipment.title: Boiler and air conditioner
equipment.description: All optional. The numbers are on the datasheet or the energy label. Whatever you leave empty, HeatWise replaces with an average for that kind of device; you can fill it in later from Configure.

data_description.boiler_model: Only for you to remember, e.g. Beretta Quadra Green 25 CSI.
data_description.boiler_power_kw: Heating, not hot water. Gives the first guess of gas per burner hour.
data_description.boiler_efficiency_pct: The full-load value against Hi, e.g. 97.5. Condensing boilers show more than 100 % at low load.
data_description.ac_heat_w: Rated heating capacity, e.g. 3399 W. Together with the power input it gives the AC efficiency (COP).
data_description.ac_input_w: Rated power consumption when heating, e.g. 916 W.
data_description.ac_energy_class: Used only if the two numbers above are empty.

init.title: HeatWise
init.description: What do you want to change?

data.warm_off_threshold: Stop heating above this outdoor temperature
data.window_detect: Guess open windows from a fast temperature drop
data.window_drop: Temperature drop that means a window (°C)
data.window_hold_minutes: Keep the heating low for at most (minutes)

data_description.boiler_entity: Optional. Leave empty for a house heated only by air conditioners.
data_description.house_temp_sensor: Optional. Without it the thermostat's own reading is used.
data_description.persons: Optional. Without people HeatWise assumes someone is home.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional. A Schedule helper works best. Without it: comfort while someone is home.
data_description.language: Automatic follows Home Assistant. The panel and the decision texts use this language.
data_description.window_detect: Works without window sensors. Uses room sensors and the wall thermostat only, never the reading of a valve or an AC.
data_description.window_drop: A heated room rarely cools more than 0.3–0.5 °C in 10 minutes; cold air from an open window does much more.
data_description.window_hold_minutes: Heating comes back earlier as soon as the room starts warming up again (window closed).
data_description.house_humidity_sensor: Optional. With it HeatWise keeps the house warm against mould when the humidity stays high.

hybrid.title: Air conditioner and prices
hybrid.description: HeatWise picks the cheaper source when both prices are known, otherwise it uses the outdoor threshold. Gas billed in m³: 1 m³ ≈ 10.5 kWh.

data.ac_threshold: Use the AC above this outdoor temperature (without prices)
data.gas_price: Gas price per kWh (if no sensor)
data.electricity_price: Electricity price per kWh (if no sensor)

power.title: Boiler power plug
power.description: A smart plug with power measurement on the boiler shows when the burner runs. With it HeatWise also estimates the gas used and its cost.

data.gas_by_power: Count gas by the plug power (modulation)

data_description.gas_meter_entity: A sensor with the meter index in m³, e.g. from your gas supplier's integration or a pulse counter. HeatWise learns the real gas use per burner hour from every new reading. You can also type a reading in the HeatWise panel or in the Gas meter reading entity at any time.
data_description.gas_rate: Starting value until HeatWise learns it from the meter. A 24 kW boiler burns up to about 2.5 m³/h.
data_description.gas_kwh_per_m3: Written on the gas bill (calorific value); about 10.5 kWh in Romania.
data_description.gas_by_power: A modulating boiler's fan draws more power when it burns more gas, so a burn at a higher power counts more. Every meter reading corrects the scale.
data_description.split_hot_water: For a combi boiler: burner time while the main thermostat is not calling for heat is hot water (shower, tap). Heating cost then leaves it out. Needs the main thermostat.

add_zone.title: Add a zone
add_zone.description: A zone needs at least radiator valves or an air conditioner.

data_description.ac_power_sensors: Smart plugs or meters with the power of the ACs in this room. HeatWise counts their energy and cost while they heat.

zone.title: Edit a zone
zone.description: A zone needs at least radiator valves or an air conditioner.

data_description.ac_power_sensors: Smart plugs or meters with the power of the ACs in this room. HeatWise counts their energy and cost while they heat.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. With it HeatWise keeps this room warm against mould when the humidity stays high.

smart.title: Smart start
smart.description: HeatWise learns how fast every room warms up and starts heating early, so it is warm when the schedule turns to comfort. With distance sensors from the Proximity integration it also warms the house up when someone is on the way home.

data.arrival_km: Warm up when someone heading home is closer than (km)
data.mould_min_temp: Then keep the room at least (°C)

data_description.preheat: Needs a Schedule helper. Until HeatWise has measured a warm-up it assumes 1.5 °C per hour.
data_description.arrival_sensors: One per person, e.g. sensor.home_alex_distance. The direction-of-travel sensor of the same Proximity entry is used when present.
data_description.mould_protection: Needs humidity sensors on the house or the rooms. After hours of high humidity HeatWise sends a message to air the room and does not let it drop below the temperature you choose, even when nobody is home. It ends when the humidity is 3 % lower.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Messages go to the notify services you pick (the mobile app, Telegram, persistent notification…).

data.notify_window_targets: Also send the window alerts to
data.notify_offline: Thermostat, valve or AC stops responding (15 min)
data.weekly_report: Weekly report on Sunday at 19:00 (gas, electricity, cost)

data_description.notify_window_targets: Only the window messages go here, e.g. the phone of someone else at home. The targets above get every message.

error.zone_needs_device: Add at least one radiator valve or air conditioner.

meter_negative.message: The gas meter index cannot be negative.

meter_too_low.message: This index is lower than the last reading ({last} m³). Check the digits; a new meter starts from a much lower index.
